fact: The strategy, approved by MBS management for the 2021-2023 plan period, states that the Malawi Bureau of Standards is the National Standards Body in Malawi under the MBS Act (Act No. 14 of 2012); its list of proposed standards names none on information technology, only electricity-meter data exchange and banking PIN items as proposals.
title: Malawi National Standardization Strategy (2021 - 2023)
